title: bug: the control-checkout follow gives up on a transient .git/index.lock, so a QA claim right after a landing can park the row with MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_BEHIND
description:
Observed live on 2026-11-02 at 20:15:16Z, the first hour of worktree mode. qa-7328a40d's follow failed `git merge -q --ff-only` with "Unable to create '/mnt/d/projexts/moes/.git/index.lock': File exists". moe/control stayed at 7beed0bc, behind moe/work-2026-10-24 at 58c760f4. At 20:15:32Z the lock was gone, and a later follow had moved HEAD to 58c760f4. No row was parked this time.

Who uses the control checkout's index at the same time:
- the IDE: PyCharm's Windows git refreshes. Two Windows git processes were live at 20:15:32Z.
- peer wrappers: their follows, `git push refs/moe/board`, landings.

The defect:
- follow_control_checkout (scripts/moe-agent.sh, about line 6735) and its twin Invoke-MoeControlFollow (scripts/moe-agent.ps1, about line 6123) retry nothing on a lock error.
- They tolerate only one case: a peer's follow that held the lock and itself moved HEAD to the tip.
- The commit path already retries this: moe-agent.sh about :5081 ("5 x 2 s retry on index.lock"), and the ps1 twin about :5200-5209.

Why it matters: qa_control_preflight runs the follow, then qa_landed_gate checks that the claimed row's completion is in the control HEAD. If the follow lost a transient lock race for a row landed seconds earlier, the gate worktree_stops the seat with MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_BEHIND and one report_blocked. That row has no blockedOnTaskIds, so it stays BLOCKED until a governor or human resets it. With about 8 coders landing and 3 QA seats claiming right after landings, that race is likely.

Fix, in both twins only: when the ff-only merge's stderr contains `index.lock`, re-check HEAD (keep the existing peer-moved-HEAD shortcut), sleep 2 s and retry. Use the same cap as the commit path, at most 5 tries. Every other failure path, and the final MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_BEHIND alert after the last try, stays exactly as it is today. Never delete an index.lock.

Files: scripts/moe-agent.sh, scripts/moe-agent.ps1, scripts/tests/postflight-worktree.cjs. The existing 'lock' case (about :1238) must keep passing: a lock held throughout still ends in BEHIND, with the lock not deleted.
definitionOfDone: follow_control_checkout (sh) and Invoke-MoeControlFollow (ps1) retry the ff-only merge up to 5 times, 2 s apart, only when its error output contains index.lock. After each failed try they re-check whether HEAD already reached the tip.
A new postflight-worktree.cjs case passes under both postflight.sh and postflight.ps1: an index.lock that is released about 3 s into the follow ends with MOE_CONTROL_ADVANCED and HEAD at the tip.
The existing 'lock' case still passes: a lock held for the whole retry window ends in MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_BEHIND, and the lock file is never deleted.
Every other follow failure path (DIVERGED, the .moe-paths BEHIND, NOT_FOLLOWING) behaves as before and does not retry.
bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh passes. The verification command (bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh, plus the ps1 harness for the twin) exits 0 from the task worktree.
